name: Ulla
title: Asherite Patriarch
summary: Ulla is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles who belonged to the tribe of Asher. He is known only from a genealogy and was the father of Ara, Hanniel, and Rishah. His descendants are described as skilled warriors and leaders among the tribe of Asher.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Asher
keyEvents.description: Ulla is mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher as the father of three sons: Ara, Hanniel, and Rishah.

keyEvents.title: Description of Descendants
keyEvents.description: Ulla's descendants and others in the tribe of Asher are described as heads of families, chosen ones, skilled warriors, and leaders among the chiefs.

keyEvents.title: Mustering of the Tribe of Asher
keyEvents.description: The tribe of Asher, to which Ulla belonged, was counted and mustered as part of the tribes of Israel, with a total of 26,000 men fit for battle.

keyEvents.title: Asher's Inheritance
keyEvents.description: As part of the tribe of Asher, Ulla's descendants received their allotted inheritance in the Promised Land, in accordance with God's promise to Israel.
